findings.title: Secret baked into Dockerfile
findings.message: ENV DB_PASSWORD sets a literal secret
findings.remediation: Pass secrets at runtime, or use BuildKit `--mount=type=secret` during the build.

findings.title: Risky docker-compose service configuration
findings.remediation: Drop privileged/host settings, bind ports to 127.0.0.1, and keep databases on an internal network.

findings.title: Risky docker-compose service configuration
findings.message: Service 'db' publishes database port 5432:5432 on all interfaces
findings.remediation: Drop privileged/host settings, bind ports to 127.0.0.1, and keep databases on an internal network.

findings.title: Base image not pinned to a version
findings.remediation: Pin the image to a specific version tag, or better a digest (image@sha256:...).

findings.title: Container runs as root
findings.message: The final stage never switches away from root
findings.remediation: Create an unprivileged user and switch to it with a USER instruction.

findings.title: ADD used instead of COPY
findings.remediation: Use COPY, and download remote files with curl plus a checksum check.

findings.title: No .dockerignore
findings.remediation: Add a .dockerignore listing .git, node_modules, .env and build output.

findings.title: No HEALTHCHECK
findings.message: The final stage has no HEALTHCHECK
findings.remediation: Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction that calls a lightweight endpoint.

findings.title: Build tools left in the final image
findings.message: Single-stage image installs or runs build tools
findings.remediation: Use a multi-stage build and copy only the built artifacts into the final stage.

findings.title: Package install leaves caches or extras
findings.message: Layer bloat: apt-get install without --no-install-recommends; apt lists are not removed
findings.remediation: Use `apt-get install --no-install-recommends` and remove /var/lib/apt/lists in the same RUN; use `apk add --no-cache`.
